title: Wednesday Greenmarket at Bartel-Pritchard Square
description:
Nestled inside Prospect Park’s tree-shaded southwest corner, this much-loved market is where South Slope and Windsor Terrace residents stock up on locally grown staples. The offerings range from a selection of vegetables, fruits, baked goods, plants and flowers to fresh-caught fish and organic baked goods.   
     
   For a full calendar of events and a list of sellers, visit the GrowNYC website.

title: Exhibit: The Shirley Chisholm Way: Brooklyn’s Blueprint for Change
description:
Join Prospect Park Alliance and Shirley Chisholm Cultural Institute (SCCI) for a new exhibit that explores how Brooklyn’s beloved daughter broke down gender and racial barriers to fight for her community, becoming the first Black woman elected to Congress.  
 The exhibit is organized around seven life lessons drawn from Chisholm’s tenacious career. It features stunning portraits of Chisholm by art
